questions.explanation:
Aldehydes and ketones can be reduced to hydrocarbons by the action of amalgamated zinc and concentrated hydrochloric acid (Clemmensen reduction), or of hydrazine and a strong base like or potassium tert-butoxide in a high-boiling alcohol like ethylene glycol or triethylene glycol (Wolf-Kishner reduction )



group and alkene are acid - sensitive groups so clemmensen reduction can not be used. Acid sensitive substrate should be reacted in the Wolf-Kishner reduction which utilise strongly basic conditions.
